# LOS-151 independent saved comparison cards

**AUTHORED UNRUN.** Source-only phase: no compiler, framework, DB, capture, native,
Reader/store, build, installed consumer, server, Map/client/browser or person run.
The comparison module and proposed Reader forwarding are deliberately unwired.
Root owns those seams and finite execution/signing/delivery admissions. All17
remain unqualified. These cards cannot close LOS-151's Reader-to-Map outcome.

The fixture is small public Rails source with Order/User and a receipt job.
`expected_cards.json` states independent expected answers before execution. It
does not copy a candidate answer. Cards separately cover changed source,
declaration metadata, relationships, unchanged User, genuine scoped removal,
addition with no prior lines, duplicate identity, runtime-model table metadata
without false removed/added, partial capture without false deletion, and unrelated
source that must not pollute the selected root's witnesses.

The native tests cover lower-level identity/ordinal/default/order, source
integrity, exact work/cursor/byte-cut and malformed input controls. The forwarding
test loads the **actual** Reader with only a Native transport double. It remains
unrun until Root implements the facade; no fake Reader is supplied.

After Root integrates and admits an exact installed candidate, reuse the existing
installed harness. Copy this entire fixture outside the source checkout, use a
fresh installed gem environment, retain package/native/fixture/card hashes and
the precise Ruby/platform tuple, and set `THISTLE_FIXTURE_INSTALLED_ROOT` to the
explicit installed gem root. The producer refuses a checkout-loaded Core.
Dependencies are the reviewed candidate and Rails **8.1.4** plus SQLite; the
public `:memory:` configuration is written **before** Active Record lazy loading.
No dependency acquisition is authorized by these files.

Run producer and consumer as separately bounded processes, never pipe a failed
producer into dependent consumption. Root's harness must retain both stdout and
stderr, check child exit, enforce its time/output/resource budgets, and stop
dependent work on failure. The intended entry points are:

```text
ruby produce.rb NEW_PUBLIC_WORK_DIRECTORY > producer-receipt.json
ruby consume.rb producer-receipt.json expected_cards.json > consumer-result.json
```

These lines describe future separately admitted execution. They are not a
standalone safe orchestration wrapper or an authorization to run them now.

Producer A records loaded framework observations and captured original source.
B edits Order's source callback/default/receiver, changes the loaded model table
field explicitly, removes a declaration file and adds new/unrelated declarations.
Edited source is never evaluated/reloaded. Thus loaded registrations and source
can disagree, and coherence must remain unknown. The partial variant records
incomplete source inventory. C publishes changed source after all selected
versions. A fresh consumer must still answer using the exact A/B or A/partial
pair, with no framework/application boot, record/job execution or Git calls.

Consumer verifies every card, original physical source IDs/path/spans and payload
hashes, finite A/B direct-reference continuation, reversed-pair refusal, closed
Reader refusal, no Woods load and unchanged CURRENT/manifests/facts/blobs. The
runtime consumer prints its supported result only when these controls actually
pass; its current file is an authored contract, not a retained pass. Raw source
coordinates remain physical and line diff unavailable. Native success-envelope
bytes include the actual wrapper and no invented newline.

Root must retain any failed producer/consumer/candidate attempt and correct a
demonstrated fixture assumption without changing these independent expectations
to fit a misleading answer. Broader real commit/branch/history/co-change/test
evidence belongs to LOS-12. The [served protocol](served_protocol.md) retains
Map/MCP/customer gates; all are unrun for this component.
